```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(GenomicRanges)
})

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")                     
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")

output_dir   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output", "feature_scores", "cicero")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
input_folder <-  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores", "cicero")
promoter_peaks_bedfile <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "TSS_plusminus500bp.bed")
```


```{r}
files <- list.files(input_folder, full.names = TRUE)
files <- files[grep("connections", files)]

for(f in files){
  message("Processing:", f)
  input_file <- f
  input_folder <- dirname(input_file)
  celltype <- sub("^cicero_connections_(.+)\\.tsv$", "\\1", basename(f))
  
  cicero <- read.table(input_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  cicero <- cicero[complete.cases(cicero), ]
  
  # Extract midpoint of Peak1
  cicero <- cicero %>%
    mutate(
      chr = sub("-.*", "", Peak1),
      start = as.numeric(sub(".*-(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", Peak1)),
      end = as.numeric(sub(".*-(\\d+)$", "\\1", Peak1)),
      mid = round((start + end) / 2)
    )
  
  # --- Load promoter BED file ---
  promoter_peaks <- read.table(promoter_peaks_bedfile, sep = "\t", header = FALSE)
  promoter_peaks <- promoter_peaks[, 1:4]
  colnames(promoter_peaks) <- c("chr", "prom_start", "prom_end", "gene")
  promoter_peaks <- promoter_peaks %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene != "." & gene != "")
  
  # --- Create GRanges objects ---
  promoters_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = promoter_peaks$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(start = promoter_peaks$prom_start, end = promoter_peaks$prom_end),
    gene = promoter_peaks$gene
  )
  
  cicero_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = cicero$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(start = cicero$mid, end = cicero$mid),
    Peak1 = cicero$Peak1,
    Peak2 = cicero$Peak2,
    coaccess = cicero$coaccess
  )
  
  ## 1) Normalize promoter seqnames to UCSC ("chr" prefix)
  if (!all(startsWith(seqlevels(promoters_gr), "chr"))) {
    new_map <- setNames(paste0("chr", seqlevels(promoters_gr)), seqlevels(promoters_gr))
    promoters_gr <- renameSeqlevels(promoters_gr, new_map)
  }
  
  ## 2) Keep only chromosomes present in both objects (you only have chr1–3 in cicero)
  common <- intersect(seqlevels(cicero_gr), seqlevels(promoters_gr))
  promoters_gr <- keepSeqlevels(promoters_gr, common, pruning.mode = "coarse")
  
  
  
  # --- Find overlaps: midpoints inside promoter regions ---
  hits <- findOverlaps(cicero_gr, promoters_gr)
  
  
  # --- Assemble result ---
  matched <- data.frame(
    Peak1 = mcols(cicero_gr)$Peak1[queryHits(hits)],
    Peak2 = mcols(cicero_gr)$Peak2[queryHits(hits)],
    coaccess = mcols(cicero_gr)$coaccess[queryHits(hits)],
    gene = mcols(promoters_gr)$gene[subjectHits(hits)]
  )
  
  # --- Final peak-gene links ---
  pgl <- matched %>%
    mutate(peak = Peak2, score = coaccess) %>%
    dplyr::select(peak, gene, score) %>%
    group_by(peak, gene) %>%
    summarise(score = mean(score), .groups = "drop")
  
  # --- Save ---
  outdir <- file.path(input_folder)
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # inside your loop where `celltype` is a single value
  outfile <- file.path(outdir, paste0("cicero_peak_gene_links_", celltype, ".tsv"))
  write.table(pgl, outfile, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  
}
```
